tool_input.body:
## Summary

`docs/CI.md` §8 listed `Cursor Automation: Find vulnerabilities` as a branch-protection required status check, but the live master ruleset (id 13438261) does not require it. Verified against the ruleset: the 8 required checks are the build matrix (×3), `install-deb`, `install-brew` (×2), `clang-format`, and `cppcheck` — no Cursor.

Cursor runs on PRs as a review but is not a required gate (it doesn't fire on every PR), which is why PRs merge without it. The doc now matches reality and explains the distinction, alongside the existing `markdownlint` note.

Found while finishing the macOS runner migration (#241).

## Test plan

- [x] Required-check list in CI.md matches the live ruleset exactly
- [ ] CI green
